LanguageData.Binguin_Scenario.label: Binguin Crash Landing
LanguageData.Binguin_Scenario.description: You wake in cryptosleep caskets, alarms and the sound of tearing metal piercing your ears. Before the ship breaks apart you barely squeeze into the escape pods. Hours later you fall upon this unfamiliar rimworld - three binguin observers, with the dry rations of the frozen plains and homemade fishing rods.
